top_signals.title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
top_signals.summary: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month's Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws -- including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook -- and comes amid important security updates from other software makers, including Adobe, Apple, Google and Mozilla.

top_signals.title: Commission approves €286 million German State aid to port of Hamburg
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 13 Nov 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, two €143 million German measures to support infrastructure works in the port of Hamburg. The measures concern two distinct infrastructure projects, one at the Salzgitter quay and one at the Steinwerder quay.
